name: てんぷら山の上 御茶ノ水本店
reopens: summer 2027 - the honten reopens inside the rebuilt 山の上ホテル 東京 / HILLTOP HOTEL TOKYO on the same Kanda-Surugadai site
address_ja: 〒101-0062 東京都千代田区神田駿河台1-1（山の上ホテル内）
cuisine: The tempura counter of the literary Hilltop Hotel - by its own account the first Tokyo hotel restaurant to serve age-dashi tempura, still frying Edo-style seasonal courses. The Surugadai honten is dark until 2027; the sibling counters run about ¥3,000 for a tendon at Nihonbashi Mitsukoshi and ¥15,000-¥29,000 for the full course at Ginza Six and Tokyo Midtown.
neighborhood: Kanda-Surugadai 1-chome, Chiyoda-ku, on the hill above Ochanomizu - 5 min from Ochanomizu (JR Chuo/Sobu line and Tokyo Metro Marunouchi line), 5 min from Shin-Ochanomizu (Chiyoda line), 6 min from Jimbocho. Not Ichigaya: the light record's Ichigaya pin was a tile centroid about 2.4 km west of the real address.
hours_raw: 御茶ノ水本店：2024年2月13日より休館中（山の上ホテル休館に伴う）。2027年夏「山の上ホテル 東京」内で再オープン予定。／営業中の直営店 - てんぷら山の上 Ginza（GINZA SIX 13F）11:00-15:00 L.O.14:00、17:00-23:00 L.O.20:30／てんぷら 山の上 Roppongi 東京ミッドタウン ガレリア 3F 11:00-15:00、17:00-22:00／てんぷら 山の上 日本橋三越本店 B1F テイクアウト10:00-19:30、イートイン11:00-19:30（L.O.19:00）、定休日は三越に準ずる
gf_detail: Tempura is wheat-flour batter by definition and this is a tempura specialist - the entire menu is koromo made from wheat flour, fried in shared oil, and the tentsuyu dipping broth is built on ordinary wheat-containing soy sauce. No gluten-free claim appears anywhere on the company site. A celiac has nothing safe to order here.
vegan_detail: Edo-mae tempura counter: prawn, kisu, conger and other seafood are the backbone of the course, the tentsuyu is katsuo dashi, and vegetable pieces come out of the same oil as the seafood. No vegetable-only or plant-based course is published.

roles: company-operated tempura restaurants of 株式会社山の上ホテル
chef_bio.origin: Kanda-Surugadai, Chiyoda-ku - the Hilltop Hotel building, a pre-war Art Deco block that became a hotel in 1954 and a byword for the Japanese literary world
chef_bio.background: てんぷら山の上 is the restaurant arm of 株式会社山の上ホテル. Its own site states that it was the first Tokyo hotel to start serving age-dashi tempura (「東京のホテルの中で最初に揚げ出してんぷらを始めた伝統ある老舗です」) and that the tradition loved by the novelists who wrote in the hotel has been handed down unchanged. The hotel closed on 13 February 2024; the company site marks the honten 休館中 'under closure' and says it will reopen in summer 2027 inside 山の上ホテル 東京. Meanwhile it runs three direct tempura outlets - Ginza (GINZA SIX 13F), Roppongi (Tokyo Midtown Galleria Garden Terrace 3F) and a takeaway/eat-in counter in the Nihonbashi Mitsukoshi basement - plus the Hilltop cafe inside Juntendo Hospital. No individual head chef is named publicly on the company's own pages, so none is asserted here.
chef_bio.philosophy: 「旬の味は、料理人の心入れひとつ。真心をいれて『真味』となる」 - the house line on the restaurant's own front page.
chef_bio.specialty: Edo-mae seasonal tempura courses; age-dashi tempura; tendon at the department-store counter.
chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: yamanoue-hotel.co.jp/tempurayamanoue/ lists the four outlets, marks 御茶ノ水本店 as 休館中, dates the hotel closure to 2024年2月13日 and gives the summer-2027 reopening inside 山の上ホテル 東京. Tabelog detail pages supply verified addresses, coordinates, phone numbers and hours for the Ginza, Roppongi and Nihonbashi Mitsukoshi branches. GSI's address-search API returns 35.697712 / 139.761398 for 東京都千代田区神田駿河台一丁目1番地.

gf_cross_contamination: Single deep-fryer tempura kitchen: every item passes through wheat batter and shared oil. There is no non-wheat preparation on the menu.
soy_sauce_wheat: Tentsuyu is made with ordinary Japanese soy sauce, which contains wheat. No tamari option is published.
vegan_cross_contact: Seafood and vegetables are fried in the same oil; tentsuyu is bonito dashi.

cultural_comfort.level: High for a general diner, unusable for celiac
cultural_comfort.note: A famous, formal but welcoming counter with an English site and reservations. Note for the app: the Chiyoda honten is shut until summer 2027, so anyone travelling before then must be sent to GINZA SIX 13F (〒104-0061 東京都中央区銀座6-10-1, 03-6264-5516), Tokyo Midtown Galleria 3F (〒107-0052 東京都港区赤坂9-7-4, 03-5413-3577) or the Nihonbashi Mitsukoshi B1F counter (〒103-0022 東京都中央区日本橋室町1-4-1, 03-3517-3230).

name: なぎちゃんラーメン in白鳥会館
address_ja: 〒169-0075 東京都新宿区高田馬場4-8-8 白鳥会館ビル B1F
cuisine: A red-noren basement ramen counter that never closes - 24 hours, seven days - serving the 'chan-kei' style of clear seisyun shoyu chuka-soba with thick straight noodles, big chashu and menma, around ¥1,000-1,999 with a chashu-don on the side.
neighborhood: Takadanobaba 4-chome, Shinjuku-ku - one minute from Takadanobaba Station (JR Yamanote line, Tokyo Metro Tozai line, Seibu Shinjuku line), in the basement of the Hakucho Kaikan building.
hours_raw: 24時間営業（月-日・祝、年中無休）。※2026年8月26日は 00:00-10:00 / 13:45- の変則営業と告知あり。
gf_detail: Ordinary wheat ramen: the shop's own listing highlights 太麺 straight wheat noodles and a 醤油スープ clear soy broth, which in Japan means wheat-containing soy sauce. No gluten-free claim of any kind appears on the listing, and a single-pot noodle station cannot separate wheat. A celiac cannot eat here.
vegan_detail: Pork-and-chicken ramen shop - chashu, focaccia-thick pork slices and a chashu-don are the house items, and the broth is animal-based. No plant-based option is listed.

chef_bio.background: なぎちゃんラーメン is a fast-growing small chain - Tabelog lists branches at Nishi-Ogikubo (the honten), Omori, Keikyu Kamata, Asakusabashi, Kinshicho, Aomono-yokocho, Musashi-koyama, Ekoda, plus Chiba (Gyotoku, Nishi-Funabashi) and Kanagawa (Motosumiyoshi, Hakuraku, Kikuna). Reviewers place it inside what the Tokyo ramen scene now calls 'ちゃん系' - cheap, round-the-clock, clear-soup chuka-soba shops descended from the Chiyo-chan / Marugen lineage. The Takadanobaba outlet sits in the basement of the Hakucho Kaikan building a minute from the station and trades 24 hours. No owner or head chef is named on any page found, so none is asserted here.
chef_bio.specialty: Clear shoyu chuka-soba, thick straight noodles, chashu-don; open around the clock.
chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Tabelog's detail page for なぎちゃんラーメン in白鳥会館 (13315959) carries Restaurant JSON-LD giving 東京都新宿区高田馬場4-8-8 白鳥会館ビル B1F, coordinates 35.713682 / 139.703561, genre ラーメン, price band ￥1,000-￥1,999 and 24-hour opening, plus a reviewer describing it as 'ちゃん系' with a red noren. gf_cross_contamination: Single-pot wheat-noodle station; no separate preparation.

name: ふじや
address_ja: 〒162-0044 東京都新宿区喜久井町25
cuisine: A tiny, almost unmarked family shokudo halfway up Natsume-zaka behind Waseda - no menu board at all, just whatever the day's teishoku is: simmered fish with kiriboshi-daikon, pork-loin shogayaki, aji-fry, hamburg, katsu-don, and the omurice students call 'Wase-omu'. About ¥1,000-1,999, lunch and an early supper only.
neighborhood: Kikui-cho, Shinjuku-ku, on Natsume-zaka just past the Tonkatsu Yutaka corner - 5 min from Waseda Station exit 2 (Tokyo Metro Tozai line), 10 min from Wakamatsu-Kawada (Toei Oedo line), 15 min south of Takadanobaba.
gf_detail: Nothing here is gluten-free and nothing is claimed to be. The house dishes are aji-fry and tonkatsu (wheat flour, egg, panko, shared fryer), hamburg, katsu-don and omurice; the nimono, the katsu-don broth and the miso soup are all built on ordinary wheat-containing soy sauce, and the miso is standard. A one-room shokudo with a single fryer and a single pot has no way to isolate wheat even if asked. A celiac should not eat here.
vegan_detail: A meat-and-fish teishoku shop: every documented plate is fish, pork or egg, the soup is katsuo dashi as a matter of course, and there is no printed menu to negotiate from. Nothing plant-based is offered.

chef_bio.origin: Kikui-cho, Shinjuku-ku - the Waseda side of Natsume-zaka, the slope named for Natsume Soseki, who was born on it
chef_bio.background: A small, long-standing neighbourhood shokudo run by its owners, feeding Waseda students and the surrounding offices. It keeps no signboard menu - reviewers note that the noren and sign are out but nothing tells a passer-by what is served, so it is effectively a regulars' shop. It is open only for a lunch service and an early evening service, four days a week, and closes Wednesday, Saturday, Sunday and public holidays. Tabelog reviews from returning customers are titled 復活してた ('it's back'), indicating a break in service at some point before it resumed; it is trading now on both Tabelog and Gnavi with identical hours and phone number. No chef is named publicly, so none is asserted here.
chef_bio.specialty: Nizakana teishoku, pork-loin shogayaki, aji-fry, katsu-don, omurice.
anecdotes: Gnavi's top-rated dish is the 煮魚定食, with a customer noting that the kiriboshi-daikon side was as good as the fish.
Waseda blogs call the omurice 'ワセオム'.
chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Tabelog 13080836 carries Restaurant JSON-LD: 東京都新宿区喜久井町25, 35.70308 / 139.72233, tel 03-3203-0419, genre 食堂, band ￥1,000-￥1,999, and the four-day 11:30-13:30 / 17:30-19:30 schedule with 水・土・日・祝 closed. Gnavi hz88fjaf0000 independently gives the same address 〒162-0044 東京都新宿区喜久井町25, the same phone, the same hours, coordinates 35.7031314 / 139.7224581 and the genre 食堂・定食. Tabelog's keyword cloud for the shop lists 豚ロース, 生姜, アジフライ, カツ丼, 刺身定食, ハンバーグ定食, 日替わり定食, 豚キムチ丼.

gf_cross_contamination: One-room shokudo with a single deep fryer used for aji-fry and tonkatsu; no separate wheat-free preparation is possible or claimed.
soy_sauce_wheat: Nimono, katsu-don broth and seasonings are ordinary Japanese soy sauce, which contains wheat.
vegan_cross_contact: Katsuo dashi in the soup; fish, pork and egg across the menu.

cultural_comfort.note: Genuinely welcoming once you are inside, but there is no menu board, no English, seating for very few, and reviewers describe sharing a table at peak. Go at the start of a service, expect to be asked what you want with no list to point at, and do not plan on negotiating ingredients.

enrich_note: Confirmed, with a cuisine correction. The name ふじや is right and the shop is real: Tabelog and Gnavi independently give the same address (東京都新宿区喜久井町25), phone (03-3203-0419), hours and coordinates, so loc_precise is set true and the centroid pin has been replaced. The light record's cuisine, 鰻・丼 (eel and donburi), is wrong - it is a 食堂・定食 shokudo whose documented dishes are simmered fish, shogayaki, aji-fry, katsu-don and omurice; there is no eel. The light record also placed it at Takadanobaba; it is actually 15 minutes south, by Waseda Station on Natsume-zaka, still Shinjuku-ku. GF set to 'no' on the fryer and wheat-soy evidence, overriding the sweep's 'ask'.
